name: Chinese calendar
leap_rule: Astronomical new moon (Beijing); month 11 contains the winter solstice; in a 13-month year the first month without a major solar term is the leap month.
sources: Reingold, E. M. and Dershowitz, N., Calendrical Calculations, 4th ed., Cambridge University Press, 2018, ch. 19
Meeus, J., Astronomical Algorithms, 2nd ed., Willmann-Bell, 1998, ch. 49 (new moon)
